description.narrative: This recently-launched USAID program is part of a larger U.S.~government effort to promote democratic representative governance in Venezuela and similar to democracy and governance support in various countries around the world. The program responds to increasing government control over news and information available on broadcast media and seeks to increase the availability of independent news to lower-income Venezuelans, who generally lack ongoing, fast Internet access.
